attBesluta.text: Best purchase yet, holds my 45qt RTIC cooler slap full of ice and drinks plus 2 10x10 tents hitting net tee and all of our ball park essentials. Highly recommend this wagon
Bought this early summer. Went through a whole season of travel baseball and the wagon is still holding up good.

This is a great product, leaves the standard carts for dead. We have used it a few times now for carting 2 large camp chairs, various bags, water bottles, esky, tent, and an XL metal dog crate on top. Carries it all with ease. The bonus is, despite being bigger, it has a much smaller volume when folded up. More than happy with this product 👍

5 Sterne Deluxe:) Also ich war erst etwas im Schock wie riesig der Wagen ist, aber auf dem Festival hat er sich absolut beweisen können. Komplett voll geladen (5 Zelte etc) lief er gut über eine Wiese. Er hat sich auch bergab als Go Cart für Erwachsene beweisen können:-D (Allerdings kann man nicht lenken, also bitte kein freestyle) Aktuell kann ich ihn nur empfehlen, mal gucken wie lang er so stabil ableistet! (Total praktisch wäre noch ne Abdeckung gegen Regen, wenn man ihn draußen stehen lässt. Oder etwas weit gedacht, ne stabile Abdeckung, sodass man ihn noch als Tisch benutzen kann)

Great item and easy to pack for any event. I love that it takes up less space than others I've had in the past and the extra storage on the bottom comes in handy.. The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is the following. I would love for it to be a bit longer. Sometimes I bring my pop up tent to sporting events and it hangs out too far so it drags on the ground. Also, could use a litte more length up top for a few extra items. Even if there was a way to drop the back like a tailgate to extend would be amazing and then I'd for sure give it a 5. Overall, happy with the purchase.
Good quality for the price. Tires are smaller than advertised though. 6.5x3.25 instead of 7x4.
Its multi-section design makes it easy to carry, and its smooth feel makes it perfect for beginners in fly fishing.
The kit is complete, the fly fishing reel is lightweight, and it's beginner-friendly.

Après utilisation, j’ai constaté un jeu latéral important au niveau de la barre de direction. La barre présente un mouvement anormal de gauche à droite, ce qui est clairement visible sur la vidéo jointe. Ce jeu me semble anormal pour un produit neuf et soulève des questions concernant la rigidité, la stabilité et la sécurité lors de l’utilisation. Je souhaite donc signaler ce défaut afin qu’il puisse être examiné et qu’une solution appropriée puisse être proposée. La vidéo jointe montre clairement le mouvement constaté.
Easy enough to put together. Great idea. Seat is too small. Needs a brake to keep it from rolling on a slope.
